title: Bubbly Beer Bread
description: A hands-on, rich and malty loaf made from self-raising flour, caster sugar and dark beer. Goes perfectly with butter and a hearty stew.

ingredients.text: 380g self-raising flour, plus a pinch for dusting

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Grease and line a standard loaf tin.
Sift the flour into a bowl and add the sugar then the beer gradually so it doesn't froth too much. Mix with a wooden spoon and transfer to the tin.
Dust the top with a little flour before putting in the oven.
Bake for 45–50 minutes until the crust is golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Turn out on to a wire rack to cool.
notes: Serves 8–10. Pale ale works as a substitute. Even lemonade makes a sweet, salty loaf good with cheese.
